pages.text: Craft Shisha from exactly $(item)1 loose tobacco$() plus $(item)1 to 3 full flavored Molasses bottles$(). Any suitable single-variety cut or Blended Tobacco is accepted; no unrelated items may be present.

pages.title: Wet Treatment
pages.text: Unlike Flavoring Essence, which lightly cases aromatic tobacco, each flavored molasses bottle is a $(thing)full one-use wet treatment$(). A bottle used for shisha is consumed and leaves an empty Glass Bottle.

pages.title: Best Cut
pages.text: Any cut works, but cut still affects product quality. $(thing)Rough Cut$() is ideal, Ribbon is second-best, Flake is workable but capped lower, and Shag is strongly penalized. Aging, fermentation, ruined state, blend data, and other tobacco metadata are preserved.

pages.title: Blends
pages.text: Using 2 or 3 flavored Molasses bottles records multiple flavor applications on the Shisha. Duplicate flavors are allowed. Unused Shisha may be flavored again until its three flavor slots are full; once it has durability damage from use, the flavor set is locked.

pages.title: Create Mixer
pages.text: With Create installed, mix $(item)1000 mB flavored molasses$() with loose tobacco in a Mechanical Mixer. The same metadata-preserving route can add another full flavored-molasses treatment to unused shisha.
